evidence.note: Data source kind declares Authentication = [Aad = [AuthorizationUri, Resource]]. The connector relies on the platform AAD flow and implements no OAuth, PKCE, or token refresh of its own.
Requests go through Web.Contents(apiUrl, [Headers, Content = postData, ManualStatusHandling, IsRetry]) as a POST to the ARM Resource Graph endpoint.
subscription and managementGroup are Azure resource IDs supplied as text, optionally comma-separated (ProcessParam, lines 144-149).
Optional options record with a resultTruncated logical field.
other: the user supplies a KQL query text (and an optional scope enum, lines 17-21). No listed id fits a KQL query.

options-fields.text: Accepts one optional field, resultTruncated (logical; allowed values true/false). When omitted it defaults to true (line 73), which forces nextSkipToken to null (line 78), so no further pages are requested.

evidence.note: Declares the options record and its resultTruncated field.
Default resultTruncated handling and nextSkipToken forced to null when resultTruncated is true.
The skip token is sent as the $skipToken option in the request body.
The next token is read from the previous page's SkipToken metadata.
Pages are generated by the module's Table.GenerateByPage.
The local Table.GenerateByPage builds pages with List.Generate (lines 206-210).

paging-stop.text: Paging stops when the response carries no $skipToken (GetSkipToken returns null, line 153), or when resultTruncated is true (the default), which forces the next token to null (line 78). ARGImpl returns null once the token is null (lines 56-61), and List.Generate ends on a null page (line 208).

evidence.note: Returns the $skipToken field or null.
nextSkipToken is null when resultTruncated is true.
List.Generate stops when getNextPage returns null.
The response body is parsed with Json.Document(result).
Column names come from Record.FieldNames of the first returned row, applied with Table.ExpandRecordColumn.

The table type is set from the first page's column types via Value.ReplaceType(Value.Type(firstRow[Column1])). The return type in AzureResourceGraphType is a bare table (line 42), so no schema is declared.
ManualStatusHandling = {500, 400}.
Retry loop: HTTP 500 yields null and is retried through Value.WaitFor.

retry-rule.text: Only HTTP 500 is retried, through Value.WaitFor with count 3 (line 106). The producer runs for iterations 0 to 2, and each attempt is delayed by 2^iteration seconds (1s, 2s, 4s; line 106). A 500 returns null to trigger another attempt (line 103). The error branch for 500 applies only at iteration 3, which the count limit does not reach. If the last attempt still fails, the result is null and later fails on response[IsError]. HTTP 400 is not retried; it returns IsError = true at once (line 103). Other non-200 statuses are returned as success with the body (line 103).

evidence.note: Status-to-result mapping: 500 retries, 400 errors, other statuses pass the body through.
Delay is 2^iteration seconds with count 3.
